thread:
deploybot: Promote attempt for release bundle-2026-03-23 failed in artifact-index compaction step: 3 missing index entries reported. Promotion paused.

maria: noticed in staging, smoke tests 500 on blob lookup.

aj: paste logs?

deploybot: compact_index.go:142: ERROR: index compacter lost entries: missing blob 7f3a2e (expected 1 refs)
compact_index.go:148: Retrying 3/3
mirror-sync.go:87: WARN: mirror ended normally but missing refs reported

Tim: Did compaction overlap with the mirror push? GC/compaction race seems likely.

devops: Yes — index-compact cron fired at 03:00 UTC and overlapped with artifact mirror push for the bundle. We'll need a lock.

maria: Can we pin to the previous stable manifest and promote to hit the change window?

aj: Pin-to-last-good manifest is safest. Command: `deployctl promote --target=prod --pin-manifest=bundle-2026-03-22-2310`

release-manager: Any downstream compatibility issues if we pin?

sre-oncall: Clients verify digests; pinning to a signed manifest is safe. Side-effect: newest artifacts not in prod yet.

devops: I can re-run reindex + compaction under a cluster lock, ETA ~12 minutes.

maria: Do the manual pin for the change window. @devops reindex and confirm when done.

aj: Manual promote run by aj at 1730456802 -> success. Prod now at bundle-2026-03-22-2310. Promote record: promote-55102. Auto-promote disabled for 1h.

aj: quick smoke: /health OK, key endpoints returning 200, no error spikes.

release-manager: Adding note to release: "Previous stable bundle promoted due to artifact index compaction race; full reindex underway."

devops: Reindex finished at 1730456820. Verified missing blobs re-registered and manifest reconciled. Compaction patched to acquire cluster-wide lock (PR #4890). Second compaction run produced no missing entries.

maria: Thanks. Please add an automated integration test to prevent compaction+push overlap.

release-manager: Filing blameless incident doc, will include timeline and rationale for manual pin.

sre-oncall: Marking incident P2, adding mitigation steps and follow-ups.

maria: Closing thread — thanks all.
